entities.summary: Nemuro Main Line is a railway line in Hokkaido. Following the closure of the Furano-Shintoku section on 1 April 2024 the line is operated by Hokkaido Railway Company in two sections, being Takikawa to Furano and Shintoku to Nemuro. Nemuro is the most easterly situated station on the Japanese rail system. Classified as Tier D (Quantitative) evidence. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
